name: rupakarsa
description: Rupakarsa — AI production workspace with separate Creator and CMS surfaces

scripts.dev:creator: npm run dev -w @rupakarsa/creator
scripts.build: npm run build:creator && npm run build:cms
scripts.build:creator: npm run build -w @rupakarsa/creator
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rupakarsa/creator && npm run lint -w @rupakarsa/cms
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rupakarsa/creator && npm run typecheck -w @rupakarsa/cms
scripts.cf:build:creator: npm run cf:build -w @rupakarsa/creator
scripts.cf:deploy:creator: npm run cf:deploy -w @rupakarsa/creator
